runners.name: Pied Piper
runners.comment: PIED PIPER was allowed to settle early and saved ground the entire trip then slipped through along the rail at the top of the stretch and drew off late.

runners.name: Ramblin
runners.comment: RAMBLIN rated in the middle of the pack with a rail trip then waited through the turn before altering five wide at the 1/4 pole and was gaining late for place.

runners.name: Suited and Booted
runners.comment: SUITED AND BOOTED was hustled up between horses and stalked the early pace then was urged nearing the 3/8 pole and made a mild rally in the stretch.

runners.name: Mr Randy
runners.comment: MR RANDY got away alertly and opened up on the lead while rank onto the backstretch then backed down the pace into the second turn before being headed nearing the 3/16 pole and gave way late.

runners.name: Uncle Evco
runners.comment: UNCLE EVCO settled early then waited behind the leaders into the second turn before altering seven wide nearing the 1/4 pole and made a bid but flattened out in the stretch.

runners.name: Gallo de Fuego
runners.comment: GALLO DE FUEGO chased the early pace while four wide then loomed to challenge while under strong urging nearing the 3/8 pole but had no response and came up empty in the stretch.

runners.name: Sock Monkey
runners.comment: SOCK MONKEY raced close up early then settled on the backstretch run before making a sustained bid through the second turn then drew clear.

runners.name: Glamour N Glitz
runners.comment: GLAMOUR N GLITZ was allowed to settle early and saved ground then altered five wide into the stretch and closed willingly to get up for place.

runners.name: Dagny Taggart
runners.comment: DAGNY TAGGART got away alertly then settled off the pace before waiting into the second turn then made a bid between horses resulting in a mild rally in the stretch.

runners.name: Devious Lady
runners.comment: DEVIOUS LADY was void of early speed and saved ground then was asked nearing the 1/4 pole and showed some run late.

runners.name: High Class Broad
runners.comment: HIGH CLASS BROAD was allowed to settle early with a four wide trip then was urged nearing the 3/8 pole but just raced evenly in the stretch.

runners.name: Bride
runners.comment: BRIDE moved up and assumed command on the lead before opening up on the backstretch run then led to the 1/4 pole before fading in the stretch.

runners.name: Curlin's Court
runners.comment: CURLIN'S COURT got off a step slowly and settled with a rail trip while never factoring.

runners.name: Mid Age Rage
runners.comment: MID AGE RAGE got off slowly and showed no speed early while losing contact with the field on the backstretch then never threatened.

runners.name: Bush
runners.comment: BUSH broke sharply then was rushed up and contested the pace before getting out on the turn then battled through the long drive and prevailed at the wire.

runners.name: Practical Patsy
runners.comment: PRACTICAL PATSY rated in the second flight early then split horses into the stretch and rallied late to get up for place.

runners.name: Sing the Blues
runners.comment: SING THE BLUES stalked the early pace then split horses on the turn and raced all out through the stretch before getting caught late for place.

runners.name: D J Abs
runners.comment: D J ABS was allowed to settle early then made a steady advance while four wide and was gaining late.

runners.name: Midnight Monarch
runners.comment: MIDNIGHT MONARCH got squeezed at the start then rated in the middle of the pack before angling five wide into the stretch before lugging in nearing the 1/8 pole then made a mild rally late.

runners.name: Tick Tock Tech
runners.comment: TICK TOCK TECH rated in the middle of the pack and saved ground through the turn then made a bid along the rail into the stretch but faltered late.

runners.name: Let Me Adore You
runners.comment: LET ME ADORE YOU got off slowly and showed no speed early while racing five wide through the turn then showed some run late in the stretch.

runners.name: Confidence
runners.comment: CONFIDENCE was allowed to settle early with a six wide trip then was urged nearing the 3/8 pole but made no rally in the stretch.

runners.name: Tajin Time
runners.comment: TAJIN TIME got away alertly and pressed the early pace then grabbed a brief lead on the turn before giving way in the stretch.

runners.name: Very Enhanced
runners.comment: VERY ENHANCED steadied shortly after the start then dropped back and tucked in for a rail trip but never factored.

runners.name: City of Rome
runners.comment: CITY OF ROME rated in the middle of the pack with a five wide trip then made a sustained bid into the stretch and drew clear late.

runners.name: Bergkamp
runners.comment: BERGKAMP was rushed up and set the early pace then was headed on the turn but dug in for the stretch run and held place.

runners.name: Victor Domino
runners.comment: VICTOR DOMINO was allowed to settle early and ducked in for a trip along the rail through the turn then angled six wide nearing the 1/4 pole and rallied late.

runners.name: Soap Note
runners.comment: SOAP NOTE got away alertly and pressed the early pace then grabbed a brief lead and raced all out through the stretch but was outfinished in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Psalm One Eighteen
runners.comment: PSALM ONE EIGHTEEN rated in the second flight early and saved ground then angled five wide into the stretch but just raced evenly late.

runners.name: Boot Scooter
runners.comment: BOOT SCOOTER got off slowly and showed no early speed before passing tiring rivals in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Onceortwicebefore
runners.comment: ONCEORTWICEBEFORE raced close up early before steadying and dropping back nearing the 1/2 pole then tucked in into the turn but faded in the stretch.

runners.name: Epic Max
runners.comment: EPIC MAX settled early before being asked while six wide nearing the 1/4 pole but had no response in the stretch.

runners.name: One Cool Dude
runners.comment: ONE COOL DUDE stalked the early pace then battled the leader coming off the turn and made a bid at the 1/4 pole before racing through the long drive with HERE COMES BRAYLON and prevailed at the wire.

runners.name: Here Comes Braylon
runners.comment: HERE COMES BRAYLON got away alertly and set the early pace before being headed by ONE COOL DUDE at the top of the stretch then battled through the long drive while ultimately second best.

runners.name: Excellent Empire
runners.comment: EXCELLENT EMPIRE rated in the second flight early before making a steady advance while four wide on the turn and sustained the bid into the stretch, gaining late in the final eighth.

runners.name: American Bear
runners.comment: AMERICAN BEAR rated in the second flight between horses early then was urged on the turn to contend and ran on late in the lane.

runners.name: Camp Daddy
runners.comment: CAMP DADDY raced close up early then dropped back into the turn before angling five wide into the stretch and closed willingly late.

runners.name: League of Legends
runners.comment: LEAGUE OF LEGENDS got off slowly and showed no speed early while saving ground then came under strong urging nearing the 1/4 pole and showed some run late.

runners.name: Bloodline
runners.comment: BLOODLINE was void of early speed before being shuffled back early then tucked in while never threatening.

runners.name: Downtown Connector
runners.comment: DOWNTOWN CONNECTOR settled early with a five wide trip then was asked into the stretch but just raced evenly late.

runners.name: Secured Lender
runners.comment: SECURED LENDER chased early while four wide and flashed brief foot before dropping back into the turn then was no factor in the stretch.

runners.name: Creating Havoc
runners.comment: CREATING HAVOC raced close up and stalked the early pace then loomed to challenge for the lead nearing the 1/4 pole and raced all out through the stretch, drawing clear late.

runners.name: Todo Men
runners.comment: TODO MEN got away alertly and tucked in while setting the early pace then battled through the long drive while running on to be second best.

runners.name: Spun Legacy
runners.comment: SPUN LEGACY rated in the second flight early with a rail trip then angled out into the stretch and made a bid between horses, gaining late.

runners.name: Mi Compadre
runners.comment: MI COMPADRE was allowed to settle early and saved ground then waited through the second turn before making a rail move and a mild rally late.

runners.name: Rulookinforrayray
runners.comment: RULOOKINFORRAYRAY raced close up between runners early then split horses nearing the 1/2 pole before angling five wide into the stretch and raced evenly late.

runners.name: Bourbonkoma
runners.comment: BOURBONKOMA got squeezed at the start and showed no speed early with a rail trip then never threatened.

runners.name: Storm Back
runners.comment: STORM BACK was void of early speed then dropped back further on the backstretch run while never factoring.

runners.name: Stashu
runners.comment: STASHU chased the pace while four wide early and contended for a half mile before giving way.

runners.name: Bourbon Neat
runners.comment: BOURBON NEAT got away alertly then settled and saved ground early before angling out and circling horses while six wide on the turn and took over into the stretch, drawing off in the final eighth.

runners.name: Fair Chase
runners.comment: FAIR CHASE broke sharply and set the early pace while opening up on the lead then was roused nearing the 1/4 pole and ran on through the stretch to hold on for place.

runners.name: Conley
runners.comment: CONLEY was void of early speed then waited through the turn before angling seven wide into the stretch and closed willingly late.

runners.name: Dayton
runners.comment: DAYTON settled early with a five wide trip then made a bid between horses into the stretch and a mild rally late.

runners.name: Kashville
runners.comment: KASHVILLE rated in the middle of the pack early then was urged between horses nearing the 3/8 pole before altering eight wide into the stretch but made no rally late.

runners.name: Tawalla
runners.comment: TAWALLA rated in the second flight early and chased the pace between horses before being asked into the stretch and raced evenly late.

runners.name: Shaddock
runners.comment: SHADDOCK was allowed to settle early then tucked in for the run into the turn before making a bid along the rail into the stretch but made no rally late.

runners.name: Capitola
runners.comment: CAPITOLA raced close up early and chased the pace along the rail before being urged nearing the 3/8 pole but faded in the stretch.

runners.name: Classic Glide
runners.comment: CLASSIC GLIDE was allowed to settle early and tucked in while racing at the back of the field then altered to the eight path into the stretch and rallied late, getting up in the final strides.

runners.name: Episist
runners.comment: EPISIST settled early and saved ground into the second turn then altered six wide into the stretch and made a move to take the lead but was caught on the wire.

runners.name: Leinani
runners.comment: LEINANI raced close up early with a four wide trip then ranged up to challenge for the lead nearing the 3/8 pole and took the lead into the stretch, racing all out but was caught late.

runners.name: Ivory and Ebony
runners.comment: IVORY AND EBONY rated in the second flight early between horses then angled five wide into the stretch and made a bid between horses, resulting in a mild rally late.

runners.name: Nycon
runners.comment: NYCON was hustled up and set the early pace while pressed on the lead then was headed nearing the 1/4 pole before giving way in the stretch.

runners.name: She's Our Girl
runners.comment: SHE'S OUR GIRL got off slowly and settled then circled horses while six wide on the turn and made a bid into the stretch with a mild rally late.

runners.name: Laken
runners.comment: LAKEN got away alertly and raced close up early, contending to the stretch before tiring.

runners.name: Lobby Rendezvous
runners.comment: LOBBY RENDEZVOUS moved up early while racing with a five wide trip then was urged to contend nearing the 3/8 pole but faltered in the stretch.

runners.name: Feeling Beachy
runners.comment: FEELING BEACHY chased early while four wide and flashed brief foot, contending for a half mile before fading.

runners.name: Ginger Ale
runners.comment: GINGER ALE chased the pace then loomed to contend nearing the 3/8 pole and made a bid but faltered in the stretch.

runners.name: Avalon Beach
runners.comment: AVALON BEACH was rushed up and pressed the early pace then assumed command into the turn before racing all out through the stretch and held sway on the wire.

runners.name: Midwinter
runners.comment: MIDWINTER was allowed to settle early then angled seven wide into the stretch and made a late rally to get up for place.

runners.name: Blazing Sunset
runners.comment: BLAZING SUNSET settled early then split horses into the stretch and made a late rally, running on late through the wire.

runners.name: R Last Laugh
runners.comment: R LAST LAUGH chased early while four wide then ducked in into the stretch and made a rail bid, resulting in a mild rally late.

runners.name: Bit Tipsy
runners.comment: BIT TIPSY settled early then angled six wide into the stretch and made a bid but was outfinished.

runners.name: Kodera Gale (IRE)
runners.comment: KODERA GALE (IRE) got off slowly and tucked in early then angled five wide into the stretch but just raced evenly late.

runners.name: Marigold Run
runners.comment: MARIGOLD RUN chased the pace while five wide and flashed brief foot, contended for a half mile before fading.

runners.name: Speightful Moon
runners.comment: SPEIGHTFUL MOON stalked the early pace then made a bid between horses at the 1/4 pole but gave way in the stretch.

runners.name: Cosmic Creed
runners.comment: COSMIC CREED was hustled up along the rail and grabbed a brief lead before dropping back into the turn and came up empty in the stretch.
